facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident during cleaning and preparation on TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 11 July 2017 a potential incident was recorded on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
